findings.title: No recall check for catalog products
findings.problem: The system prompt requires recall checks only for products looked up on the web, so a catalog product with a recall or safety notice can be recommended with no check, and the context has no rule covering that case.
findings.fix: Add a rule that every recommended catalog product is checked for recall or safety notices, with the same handling as web results, and that a recalled product is not recommended.
